rows.note: Every face uses nu 0.33 from the aluminium case. MAINLINE-008 published no Poisson ratio. CFRP, SiC and beryllium are not aluminium.
0.1407 replaces the handbook gamma 0.20 on the stiff branch only. It is the brief's single figure, not a fresh SP-8032 knockdown at the optimum thickness.
Densities 16, 8 and 4 have no fully sourced core in MAINLINE-007. Ec and Gc scale as rho^2 and crush strength as rho^1.5 from the 32 kg/m3 sourced row. PROJECTION.
MAINLINE-013 has not filed. Its cores are not used.
Both Plascore aluminium honeycombs lack Ec. Wrinkling is unscored, so they are excluded from the optimum.
Core crush is compressive strength over p/2. Thickness does not enter. The target is the MAINLINE-007 reading of about p/2.
Handbook gamma 0.20 is the CR-1457 hemisphere value. A complete sphere has no edge. MAINLINE-007b already recorded that the 0.20 rests on meager tests.
1/least SF is the safety-factor gap. It is the property multiple only when that mode scales in proportion to the named property. Wrinkling scales as a cube root or a square root.

Wrinkling-precision gap. Foam design coefficient 0.50, theoretical column 0.82 inside the sourced band Allen 0.78, Plantema 0.85, Hoff and Mautner 0.91. Required Ec*Gc scales as 1/coefficient^3: (0.82/0.50)^3 = 4.410943999999999. Honeycomb design coefficient 0.33 from CR-1457 eq 2.2-14. Honeycomb theoretical coefficient 0.82 from Hemp, as quoted for anti-plane cores in NASA/CR-1999-208994. QUESTIONABLE. The column is the same geometry, not a new optimum.
